optimized_sql:
SELECT
    store_sales_returns.i_item_id,
    store_sales_returns.i_item_desc,
    store_sales_returns.s_store_id,
    store_sales_returns.s_store_name,
    MAX(store_sales_returns.store_sales_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
    MAX(store_sales_returns.store_returns_loss) AS store_returns_loss,
    MAX(catalog_profit.catalog_sales_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
FROM (
    SELECT
        filtered_ss.ss_customer_sk,
        filtered_ss.ss_item_sk,
        item.i_item_id,
        item.i_item_desc,
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name,
        MAX(filtered_ss.ss_net_profit) AS store_sales_profit,
        MAX(filtered_sr.sr_net_loss) AS store_returns_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT
            ss_customer_sk,
            ss_item_sk,
            ss_ticket_number,
            ss_store_sk,
            ss_net_profit
        FROM store_sales
        WHERE ss_sold_date_sk IN (
            SELECT d1.d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d1
            WHERE d1.d_moy = 4 AND d1.d_year = 1999
        )
    ) AS filtered_ss
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            sr_customer_sk,
            sr_item_sk,
            sr_ticket_number,
            sr_net_loss
        FROM store_returns
        WHERE sr_returned_date_sk IN (
            SELECT d2.d_date_sk
            FROM date_dim d2
            WHERE d2.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d2.d_year = 1999
        )
    ) AS filtered_sr
      ON filtered_ss.ss_customer_sk = filtered_sr.sr_customer_sk
     AND filtered_ss.ss_item_sk = filtered_sr.sr_item_sk
     AND filtered_ss.ss_ticket_number = filtered_sr.sr_ticket_number
    JOIN item
      ON item.i_item_sk = filtered_ss.ss_item_sk
    JOIN store
      ON store.s_store_sk = filtered_ss.ss_store_sk
    GROUP BY
        filtered_ss.ss_customer_sk,
        filtered_ss.ss_item_sk,
        filtered_ss.ss_store_sk,
        item.i_item_id,
        item.i_item_desc,
        store.s_store_id,
        store.s_store_name
) AS store_sales_returns
JOIN (
    SELECT
        cs_bill_customer_sk,
        cs_item_sk,
        MAX(cs_net_profit) AS catalog_sales_profit
    FROM catalog_sales
    WHERE cs_sold_date_sk IN (
        SELECT d3.d_date_sk
        FROM date_dim d3
        WHERE d3.d_moy BETWEEN 4 AND 10 AND d3.d_year = 1999
    )
    GROUP BY cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk
) AS catalog_profit
  ON store_sales_returns.ss_customer_sk = catalog_profit.cs_bill_customer_sk
 AND store_sales_returns.ss_item_sk = catalog_profit.cs_item_sk
GROUP BY
    store_sales_returns.i_item_id,
    store_sales_returns.i_item_desc,
    store_sales_returns.s_store_id,
    store_sales_returns.s_store_name
ORDER BY
    store_sales_returns.i_item_id,
    store_sales_returns.i_item_desc,
    store_sales_returns.s_store_id,
    store_sales_returns.s_store_name
LIMIT 100

2. PREDICATE PUSH-DOWN — TARGET: `catalog_sales.cs_sold_date_sk` — TRANSFORMATION: restrict `catalog_sales` to Apr–Oct 1999 dates before it joins `store_returns`, shrinking the 28.8M-row fact table early.

3. PREDICATE PUSH-DOWN — TARGET: `store_returns.sr_returned_date_sk` — TRANSFORMATION: restrict `store_returns` to Apr–Oct 1999 dates before joining to `store_sales` and `catalog_sales`.

4. EARLY AGGREGATION / FANOUT ELIMINATION — TARGET: catalog_sales-to-store_returns join on `(cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk)` — TRANSFORMATION: pre-aggregate the filtered `catalog_sales` by `(cs_bill_customer_sk, cs_item_sk)` with `max(cs_net_profit)`, then join this compact aggregate instead of row-level `catalog_sales`.

5. ONE-TO-ONE COMBINE + EARLY AGGREGATION — TARGET: store_sales-store_returns join on `(sr_customer_sk, sr_item_sk, sr_ticket_number)` — TRANSFORMATION: join the filtered `store_sales` and `store_returns` on this 1:1 key, then pre-aggregate the result by `(customer, item, store)` with `max(ss_net_profit)` and `max(sr_net_loss)`, carrying `i_item_id`, `i_item_desc`, `s_store_id`, `s_store_name`.

6. FINAL GROUP/ORDER — TARGET: final `GROUP BY i_item_id, i_item_desc, s_store_id, s_store_name` — TRANSFORMATION: join the two pre-aggregated fact sets on customer+item, compute the final maxes per store-item group, then apply `ORDER BY`/`LIMIT` only to that small result.
